dev_notes: No store of their own: an event with why_from unknown or commit is the question (unknownReasons() in src/compose.mjs). askReasons() in src/commands/agent.mjs asks them at a TTY and writes why_from person; the prepare brief's section 3 has the agent ask them; cutReport() counts them as a warning; cmdOverview lists up to eight. `ledger questions` is retired with a pointer.

history.name: Reasons nobody recorded
history.description: A reason nobody gave, or one read off a commit message, stays a question until a person answers it. Bare ledger lists them, ledger agent and ledger prepare ask them, and ledger cut counts them.
history.how_to_see: Record a change with --why-unknown, then run ledger on its own: the change is listed under Reasons nobody has vouched for.
